theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Yen Inches Toward 160 Per Dollar, Raising Intervention Concerns
top_news.summary: The yen edged closer toward a key level against the dollar, raising concerns over Japanese authorities stepping in again to prop up the currency.

top_news.title: Severe Storms Hit Chicago, Disrupt Hundreds of US Flights
top_news.summary: Severe thunderstorms raked Chicago and the Midwest Tuesday, triggering tornado warnings and disrupting hundreds of flights as another round of dangerous weather swept across the US.

top_news.title: EM Assets Retreat as Iran Deal Doubts Push Oil Prices Higher
top_news.summary: Emerging-market assets fell on Tuesday, with a currency gauge snapping a four-day winning streak as fading hopes for a US-Iran deal weighed on risk sentiment.

top_news.title: S&P 500 Falls as Oil Climbs Before Inflation Data: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Wall Street traders refrained from making riskier bets before key inflation data, with stocks falling as the lack of a deal to restore energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz lifted oil prices.

top_news.title: Nvidia’s Show of Financial Force Soothes Jittery Credit Markets
top_news.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s commitments to backstop the artificial intelligence boom seemed to be swelling by the day. There was the reported $250 billion to help kickstart a massive data center for OpenAI in Ohio, the latest in a string of big financings it was involved with.

top_news.title: NYSE Parent ICE Raises $3.75 Billion for MarketAxess Takeover
top_news.summary: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. sold $3.75 billion of US investment-grade bonds on Tuesday, less than two weeks after announcing a $6 billion deal to acquire MarketAxess Holdings Inc.
